title: Grab and throw with a construct hand
desc: A construct hand forms from the ring, reaches 6 blocks on a tether, grabs the mob and throws it along the crosshair into a wall (3x3 crater); J had said "grab-throw later" in 503.

takes.name: Reach and fling
takes.facts: grab 18, release 36, hits the wall 44; 1.9 blocks a tick; yanked up in front, wound over the right shoulder, flung; hand forms 9-12, reaches 6 blocks on a tether; throw 12 deg off the mob line, 3x3 crater 16 blocks out

takes.name: Overhead whip
takes.facts: grab 18, release 38, hits the wall 45; 2.2 blocks a tick, slightly down; arced over the head and whipped down the crosshair; hand forms 9-12, reaches 6 blocks on a tether; throw 12 deg off the mob line, 3x3 crater 16 blocks out

takes.name: Spin throw
takes.facts: grab 18, one full spin 24-44 at 3.4 blocks, release 44, hits the wall 51; 2.0 blocks a tick; hand forms 9-12, reaches 6 blocks on a tether; throw 12 deg off the mob line, 3x3 crater 16 blocks out
